comparison.objective: Score and break an ampoule neck while retaining the separated cap in an opener.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual abrasive coverage, guarded breakaway, upright stabilization, and fragment-cap retention.
comparison.success_condition: Confirmed neck break, cap contained, body upright, tool returned, hands released, with no direct neck/cap contact or drop.
comparison.reason: Breakaway after circumferential abrasion and captive cap removal is meaningfully different from maintaining a continuous aligned bearing support during translation. Both prevent loss, but of different objects through different mechanisms.
